learning_outcomes.text: Explain the Byzantine fault-tolerance problem consensus protocols solve
Compare Proof of Work, Proof of Stake and BFT-style consensus and their trade-offs
Describe how public-key cryptography and digital signatures authenticate transactions
Explain hash functions, Merkle structures and their role in integrity
Reason about finality, liveness and safety under network and adversary assumptions
Identify the security and decentralisation trade-offs of each consensus design

integrative_case: A new layer-1 project must choose a consensus mechanism for a payments network expecting adversarial validators; evaluate Proof of Work, Proof of Stake and BFT options against safety, liveness, cost and decentralisation and defend the recommendation.
